on the rustscan enumeration we see that the port 21 is open and that we can connect anonymously

Now i connect to the ftp 21 port

in the ftp there are 2 txt files we can open

but first i download them using the get command

this is the task.txt

Here on the tasks list we can see a name which probably is a username with which we can connect to ssh port 22 which is also open

and this is the locks.txt

The locks.txt is probably the possible password list

Now i will try a hydra brute force on ssh port 21 with the username lin and the locks.txt file so i can find the password with the command:

hydra -l lin -P locks.txt 10.66.139.83 ssh

here we can see that the password is RedDr4gonSynd1cat3

We will now connect to the ssh and get the user.txt flag

Here is the first flag

Now we need to escalate privileges to root so we can get the root.txt flag

For doing that we will use the commands:

tar -cf /dev/null /dev/null --checkpoint=1 --checkpoint-action=exec=/bin/sh

sudo tar -cf /dev/null /dev/null --checkpoint=1 --checkpoint-action=exec=/bin/sh

The first one is used for spawning an interactive shell to break from the restricted environment and the second one is used to escalate access

Now all we have to do is to open the root directory and open root.txt file
